messages:
Lucas: Heads-up — during the all-hands the encoder spiked around slide 12. Video recording has artifacting and the livestream dropped frames for ~30s. Can ops/streaming team triage quick fix and advise how we handle Q&A backlog?
ops-bot: Incident recorded: id=AH-3345678901, severity=medium. Auto-snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/ah/3345678901/snapshots.zip
Maria_prod: On it. I swapped the OBS ingest to the backup encoder at +2m. Backup stream is healthy now but we lost ~45s of clean recording. Linking the partial clip: https://internal.redwood/recordings/3345678901/clip_part1.mp4
Olivia: Thanks Maria. For leadership: do we want to replay the lost segment, summarize it, or ask folks to resend questions that may have come in during that window?
Dex: Quick note from infra — root cause looks like encoder process hit a mem spike from a long slide GIF. I pushed a hotfix to bump ulimit and disabled hardware overlay for that session. Patch:
```
# restart encoder (hotfix)
systemctl restart encoder.service
echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/overcommit_memory
```
Tried to maintain stream continuity; backup took over smoothly.
Zara: For the Q&A: some leadership questions were typed into the qna doc at 10:12 — I copied them into Slack thread #all-hands-qa. We should call them out during the wrap up and maybe follow up asynchronously.
Tia: Recorder note — local studio iso tracks have clean audio; video gap only. I can splice the clean audio onto the backup video and deliver a patched clip by EOD.
Devon: If we want a replay, recommend we do a short 2-3min "recap + answer" segment at the end of the week to avoid re-running the whole session. That way we capture live Qs and give leadership a chance to expand. :thumbsup: 
Lucas: Sounds good. Maria/Tia can you confirm deliverable and ETA here? Also, tag any customers who asked live so support can follow up.
Maria_prod: ETA for patched clip: today 18:00 PT. I'll post link + diff notes. I'll also drop a short note in #support with timestamps of likely affected Qs.
Tia: Confirmed — delivering patched clip + iso audio file by 18:00 PT. Will include a short README of what was replaced.
Olivia: I'll schedule a 10-min follow-up segment for Friday all-hands to address any missed content and the Qs. If anyone has priority questions, DM me so I can prep answers.
Lucas: Thanks everyone. One action item list: 1) Maria/Tia deliver patched clip by 18:00 PT, 2) Maria to post support note with timestamps, 3) Olivia to add 10-min follow-up in Friday agenda, 4) Dex to open a postmortem ticket with encoder logs.
Dex: PMed the logs to #eng-runtime and opened ticket INF-8453. I'll add remediation steps and the mem spike trace.
Maria_prod: Posted support note: https://internal.redwood/support/ah-3345678901 — tagging @support for follow-ups.
Olivia: I'll prep talking points for the follow-up and post in #all-hands-prep by tomorrow.
Lucas: Cheers. If anything else crops up, ping me. :coffee:
